settings.name_in_paper: Semi-parametric dynamic contextual pricing (log-linear valuation, non-parametric residual, binary feedback)
unmapped: Posted-price problem: valuation V_t = exp(theta_0^T X_t) Z_t, sale iff V_t >= p_t, reward p_t*Y_t; only binary sale feedback observed
Residual Z_t distribution is non-parametric (unknown), support an interval in [0,1]; covariates i.i.d. with support in [-1/2,1/2]^d; theta_0 in known compact Theta subset [0,1]^d
Regret against oracle knowing theta_0 and distribution of Z, pricing z* exp(theta_0^T X_t)
The learner knows the supports, the constants alpha_1, alpha_2 and the smoothness constants kappa_1, kappa_2 (used in gamma)
settings.definition_quote: \ln V_t = \theta_0^\intercal X_t + Z'_t ... The platform sets price $p_t$, upon which the user buys the product if $V_t \ge p_t$. ... The revenue/reward at time $t$ is $p_t Y_t$ where $Y_t = \mathbbm{1}_{V_t\geq p_t}$.

symbols.alpha_1: lower bound on z*exp(theta^T x) over supports
symbols.alpha_2: upper bound on z*exp(theta^T x) over supports
symbols.kappa_1: lower curvature constant of revenue function r(z,theta) (A3)
symbols.kappa_2: upper curvature constant of revenue function r(z,theta) (A3)
symbols.gamma_alg: confidence width parameter gamma = max(10 alpha_2^2, 4 kappa_2^2/log n, kappa_1^{-2}/log n)

conditions: A1: X_t and Z_t i.i.d., mutually independent, X support in [-1/2,1/2]^d, Z support an interval in [0,1], supports known
A2: theta_0 in known connected compact Theta subset [0,1]^d
A3: kappa_1 max{(z*-z)^2, max_l (theta_0^(l)-theta^(l))^2} <= r(z*,theta_0)-r(z,theta) <= kappa_2/(d+1) ||(z*-z, theta_0-theta)||^2 (implies unique optimizer)
tuning: gamma = max(10 alpha_2^2, 4 kappa_2^2/log n, kappa_1^{-2}/log n)

source.label: thm:RegretBound
source.quote: Under A1, A2, and A3, the expected regret under policy DEEP-C with Rounds with $\gamma = \max\left(10\alpha_2^2, 4 \frac{\kappa_2 ^2}{\log n}, \frac{\kappa_1^{-2}}{\log n} \right)$ satisfies, $$\E[R_n] \le 16000\alpha_1^{-2} \alpha_2^2\kappa_1^{-2} \kappa_2^{3/2} \gamma^{3/4} d^{11/4} n^{1/2} \log^{7/4} n + 5 \alpha_2.$$

results.notes: Regret R_n = Gamma*_n - Gamma_n against oracle policy knowing theta_0 and Z distribution; expectation taken, recorded as pseudo-regret vs per-round optimal price. Compute: number of cells scales as O(n^{d/4}) per paper, so exponential in d. Horizon n used in discretization and gamma.
